text: The file being edited (a whole fn/*.fn), and Save (Ctrl+S). A text that does not parse is not saved.
The code: Python colours, and completion of function names and of @override.
What is wrong, live: types, description, and the code each backend needs (here, none for PL/SQL yet).
Test call: runs a function on Python, with the text as it is, with the arguments as a JSON array.
The list stays beside the editor; the editor slides out from behind it.
